mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, increasing infection risk in patients taking dronedarone who require maintained immune function for cardiac stability; dronedarone also has potential hepatotoxicity that may be compounded by methimazole metabolism.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly during concurrent use; ensure adequate spacing of doses and consider alternative antiarrhythmic if agranulocytosis develops; baseline and periodic liver function tests recommended.
